text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We came to the hot springs to take a breather.
...This will surely be an important rest.
I need to think carefully so she can relax to the fullest—"
choice_data_list: (The benefits of each hot spring and info on the surrounding area, all in my notebook…)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, is something the matter?
choice_data_list: It's nothing! So, is there anything you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, I have spotted amazake over there.
It should provide adequate nourishment—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (Confirmed Master's eyebrows have drawn together 2 millimeters closer than normal. She appears to be checking her notebook...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (That expression—is it "worry"? Come to think of it, I detected an unnatural quality in her previous response as well...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Which means... Master isn't enjoying this
from the bottom of their heart? There are hidden emotions?)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master.
Today, let us execute "enjoying ourselves from the bottom of our hearts."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing footbath immersion. Expected benefits:
'Autonomic nerve regulation,' 'Relaxation'—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How do you feel, Master?
I infer you are transitioning toward a state of reduced tension.
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'm starting to work up a bit of a sweat too.
Right! I'm starting to work up a bit of a sweat too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Condition: stable. Now, let us execute
"conversation." It is reported that talking while in
a footbath can be expected to increase intimacy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's perspiration confirmed.
Elevated mood confirmed. Surely your "troubles" have eas—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...! Still looking troubled.
It seems the situation hasn't improved.
—Devising the next course of action...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock, knock, knock!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rally continuing.
Master, a new high score has been achieved.
choice_data_list: Incredible, no matter how I hit it, you return it...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. Continuing execution—
The exercise program is effective for mental recovery."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Failure confirmed.
Re-evaluating strategy——...Error."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, is this...
fruit milk?
choice_data_list: I thought you might be thirsty, so here you go!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...However, there's only one.
choice_data_list: I bought this for Bourbon, you know

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to enjoy it as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I sense that you have been deeply troubled
about something with a serious expression for a while now."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you act cheerful in front of me...
I want to clear your errors.
Please, let me execute this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was a little surprised.
It seems I had caused Mihono Bourbon
unnecessary worry without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, it brought a sense of joy.
To see that she had come to reflect so deeply
upon the matters of the "heart"...
choice_data_list: You were agonizing over it because you wanted to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show my notebook.
In it, I had jotted down today's schedule
and the location of the hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...If only you had asked, I would have installed it for you.
choice_data_list: But you want to think about it, right?
But I want to think about it, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What would make this child happy?
What would be best for her...?
She pondered so deeply it showed on her face.
choice_data_list: Bourbon is precious to me, that's why!
It's because Bourbon is precious to me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Unable to complete scan.
The heart is exceedingly complex.
I can never fully comprehend it, and am left perpetually bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, it was 'warm.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Logged into memory.
'Troubles' born of 'affection'.
Thank you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After enjoying the hot springs, as we walked along the night path...
I suddenly noticed Mihono Bourbon staring over at me."
choice_data_list: Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Between Master today and my father,
I found a slight resemblance."
